Fetcher brings the right candidates to you by combining AI with a human touch. The company uses AI, scalable processes, and smart people to automate repetitive, top-of-funnel recruiting tasks so clients can focus more on candidate engagement & team collaboration.

Hometap is revolutionizing home financing, giving this generation of homeowners a new way to take advantage of the equity they’ve earned in their homes. We make investments of up to 20 percent of a current home‘s value, allowing homeowners to immediately receive cash for the things they need and want without having to incur further debt through a home equity loan or second mortgage. Because we're not a lending product, there's no set credit score required, no interest rates, and no monthly payments. We're working to change the face of homeownership through home equity investments, providing financial stability and freedom to more homeowners.

Cybersecurity threats have grown more advanced and relentless, from AI-driven phishing and ransomware to deepfakes and evasive malware. While large enterprises invest heavily to defend themselves, SMBs - who face the same risks - often lack the budget, expertise, and tools to keep up. The market has long underserved them, offering oversized, complex solutions that don’t match their needs.
